natural: a southern ox panting at the moon

meaning.en: To be so frightened by past experience that one panics at something harmless.
meaning.zh: 比喻因疑心而胡乱惊恐。

equivalents: needless fear based on a past scare

examples.zh: 他被骗过一次，现在见谁都怀疑，简直是吴牛喘月。
examples.en: Having been conned once, he now suspects everyone, panicking at nothing.

examples.zh: 别吴牛喘月了，这只是一次普通的检查。
examples.en: Don't get jumpy over nothing; it's just a routine check.

story.en: Man Fen, afraid of the wind, sat near a glass window that looked solid but was not; he joked that he was like a southern ox that pants when it sees the moon, mistaking it for the sun.
story.zh: 满奋畏风，在晋武帝座，北窗作琉璃屏，实密似疏，奋有难色。帝笑之，奋答曰：“臣犹吴牛，见月而喘。”

usage.en: Describes excessive fear. Predicate.
usage.zh: 形容过度惊恐。作谓语。原典也有“怕热”的意思。

meaning.en: To share both life and death; to stand together through all dangers.
meaning.zh: 生死与共，在任何情况下都在一起。

equivalents: stand together through life and death

examples.zh: 他们是同生共死的战友。
examples.en: They are comrades who have shared life and death.

examples.zh: 夫妻二人立下誓言，要同生共死。
examples.en: The couple vowed to share life and death together.

usage.en: Positive; for loyal friends, partners or comrades. Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 褒义，指忠诚的朋友、伴侣、战友。作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Devious and hard to deal with; also (of questions) awkward and tricky.
meaning.zh: 性情狡猾，难以对付；也形容问题怪异难答。

examples.zh: 这个人刁钻古怪，没人愿意和他打交道。
examples.en: This man is crafty and difficult; nobody wants to deal with him.

examples.zh: 考官尽出刁钻古怪的问题。
examples.en: The examiners kept asking tricky, odd questions.

usage.en: Colloquial and mildly negative. Describes people or questions. Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 口语，略带贬义。形容人或问题。作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: The colourful, tempting world of pleasures.
meaning.zh: 指繁华热闹、充满诱惑的社会，也指尘世。

equivalents: the bright lights of the world

examples.zh: 他刚到大城市，被这花花世界迷住了。
examples.en: Newly arrived in the big city, he was dazzled by its glitter.

examples.zh: 花花世界，诱惑太多，要守住本心。
examples.en: With so many temptations in this glittering world, keep true to yourself.

usage.en: Neutral to slightly critical; often hints at temptation and vice. Object.
usage.zh: 中性偏贬，常暗含诱惑。作宾语。

natural: there is nothing one would not do

meaning.en: To do any wicked thing without scruple.
meaning.zh: 没有什么坏事不敢做。

examples.zh: 为了钱，他无所不为。
examples.en: He will stop at nothing for money.

examples.zh: 这伙骗子无所不为，坑害了不少老人。
examples.en: The gang of fraudsters stooped to everything and harmed many old people.

usage.en: Derogatory in most uses. Do not confuse with 无所不能 'omnipotent'. Predicate.
usage.zh: 多含贬义。别与“无所不能”相混。作谓语。

natural: a sea of blood, deep hatred

meaning.en: A deep and bitter hatred caused by the murder of one's kin.
meaning.zh: 因亲人被杀而结下的极深仇恨。

examples.zh: 他背负着家人被害的血海深仇。
examples.en: He bore the blood-deep grudge of his family's murder.

examples.zh: 这两个家族之间有着血海深仇。
examples.en: There is a bitter blood feud between the two families.

usage.en: Serious; commonly in novels and films. Object, often with 有 or 报.
usage.zh: 语气沉重，多见于小说影视。作宾语，常与“有”“报”搭配。

meaning.en: Members of the imperial family; also a delicate, pampered person.
meaning.zh: 原指皇族子孙，也比喻出身高贵或娇生惯养的人。

examples.zh: 她是金枝玉叶，从没受过苦。
examples.en: She is a born princess and never suffered hardship.

examples.zh: 别把他当成金枝玉叶，他吃得了苦。
examples.en: Don't treat him as a pampered noble; he can stand hardship.

usage.en: Today can be teasing about pampered people. Usually of a woman or child. Object or predicate.
usage.zh: 现可戏称娇贵的人，多指女子或孩子。作宾语、谓语。

meaning.en: To walk with head high and long strides, showing pride or confidence.
meaning.zh: 眼睛向上看，迈大步走，形容态度傲慢或气概不凡。

examples.zh: 他高视阔步地走进会场。
examples.en: He strode into the hall with his head held high.

examples.zh: 队员们高视阔步入场，信心十足。
examples.en: The players entered with swagger, brimming with confidence.

usage.en: Can be admiring or critical depending on context. Predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 可褒可贬，视语境而定。作谓语、状语。

meaning.en: An isolated place cut off from real life, such as the academic world or an artist's retreat.
meaning.zh: 比喻脱离现实生活的小天地，如学术或艺术的避世之地。

examples.zh: 学者不应躲进象牙之塔，要关注社会。
examples.en: Scholars should not retreat into an ivory tower but care about society.

examples.zh: 走出象牙之塔，他才知道生活的艰难。
examples.en: Once out of the ivory tower, he learned how hard life can be.

usage.en: A borrowed term, from French 'tour d'ivoire', now common in Chinese. Object.
usage.zh: 借自法语，现已通行于汉语。作宾语。

meaning.en: To carry out orders with great care and obedience.
meaning.zh: 接受命令后极其小心谨慎地执行。

examples.zh: 他奉命唯谨，从不越权行事。
examples.en: He follows orders to the letter and never oversteps his authority.

examples.zh: 对上司的指示，她总是奉命唯谨。
examples.en: She always follows her superior's instructions with great care.

usage.en: Can be praise for diligence or a hint of lack of initiative. Predicate.
usage.zh: 可指认真负责，也可暗含缺少主见。作谓语。

meaning.en: To destroy vast forces with overwhelming power; to dominate a field completely.
meaning.zh: 形容威力巨大，能打败成千上万的敌人。

examples.zh: 他的剑法横扫千军，无人能敌。
examples.en: His swordsmanship sweeps away all comers; no one can match him.

examples.zh: 这款新游戏横扫千军，一夜间成为爆款。
examples.en: This new game swept the market and became a hit overnight.

usage.en: Heroic; often in sports, games or fiction. Predicate.
usage.zh: 气势豪迈，常用于体育、游戏、小说。作谓语。

meaning.en: Utterly exhausted, of people and animals alike.
meaning.zh: 人和马都很疲劳，形容极度疲倦。

examples.zh: 赶了一天的路，大家都人困马乏。
examples.en: After a whole day's travel, everyone was worn out.

examples.zh: 加班到深夜，团队已经人困马乏。
examples.en: After working late into the night, the team was exhausted.

usage.en: Often humorous for modern fatigue. Predicate.
usage.zh: 现代常用于戏称疲惫。作谓语。

natural: not decline even ten thousand deaths

meaning.en: To be ready to risk death a thousand times for a cause.
meaning.zh: 就是死一万次也不推辞，表示不怕任何牺牲。

equivalents: be ready to die for it

examples.zh: 为了国家，我万死不辞。
examples.en: For my country I would not refuse even death.

examples.zh: 您的恩情，我万死不辞，定当报答。
examples.en: For your kindness I'd go to any length; I will repay you.

usage.en: Pledge of loyalty or gratitude, often exaggerated in modern speech. Predicate.
usage.zh: 表忠诚或感恩的誓言，现代口语中常夸张。作谓语。

meaning.en: Zhuge Liang's wooden transport devices; by extension ingenious carrying machines.
meaning.zh: 三国时诸葛亮发明的运输工具，也指巧妙的运载机械。

examples.zh: 传说诸葛亮用木牛流马运送粮草。
examples.en: Legend says Zhuge Liang used wooden oxen and flowing horses to carry grain.

examples.zh: 博物馆展出了复原的木牛流马。
examples.en: The museum displays a reconstruction of the wooden ox and gliding horse.

story.en: The biography records that Zhuge Liang was ingenious and improved repeating crossbows and invented the wooden ox and flowing horse.
story.zh: “亮性长于巧思，损益连弩，木牛流马，皆出其意。”

usage.en: A named historical device rather than a moral idiom; used in discussions of Three Kingdoms or ingenious inventions. Object.
usage.zh: 指历史上的具体器物，常见于三国话题或谈巧妙发明。作宾语。

meaning.en: To go astray, taking a wrong or immoral path in life.
meaning.zh: 走上错误的道路。

examples.zh: 他年轻时误入歧途，后来幡然悔悟。
examples.en: He went astray in youth but later repented.

examples.zh: 要引导孩子，别让他们误入歧途。
examples.en: We should guide children so they do not take a wrong turn.

usage.en: Used of life choices, crime and mistaken methods. Predicate.
usage.zh: 用于人生选择、犯罪或错误方法。作谓语。

meaning.en: Free and easy, not bound by formality.
meaning.zh: 不拘泥于礼节和外表，自然随便。

examples.zh: 老朋友之间不拘形迹，随意就好。
examples.en: Between old friends we need no ceremony; just be at ease.

examples.zh: 他为人不拘形迹，大家都喜欢他。
examples.en: He is easy-going and unceremonious; everyone likes him.

usage.en: Usually positive; used of easy relations. Predicate.
usage.zh: 多为褒义，指关系融洽随意。作谓语。

natural: a treasure rare in the world

meaning.en: A treasure of extreme rarity.
meaning.zh: 世上少有的珍宝。

examples.zh: 这幅古画是希世之珍。
examples.en: This ancient painting is a priceless rarity.

examples.zh: 博物馆里陈列着多件希世之珍。
examples.en: The museum displays several one-of-a-kind treasures.

usage.en: Praise for objects, rarely people. Object or predicate.
usage.zh: 称赞物品，很少用于人。作宾语、谓语。

natural: the Red Prefecture, the Divine Land

meaning.en: A poetic name for China.
meaning.zh: 中国的别称。

examples.zh: 赤县神州，山河壮丽。
examples.en: The Divine Land of China, with its splendid mountains and rivers.

examples.zh: 他立志报效赤县神州。
examples.en: He resolved to serve his motherland.

usage.en: Poetic or patriotic tone. Origin: Zou Yan's theory that China was one of nine continents. Object.
usage.zh: 诗意或爱国语气，源于邹衍“赤县神州”说。作宾语。

story.en: Sima Qian records Zou Yan's geography, in which China is called 'Chixian Shenzhou' (中国名曰赤县神州), one of nine such continents. The phrase became a poetic name for China.
story.zh: 《史记·孟子荀卿列传》载邹衍之说：“中国名曰赤县神州。”后用作中国的美称。

natural: smudge the clouds to set off the moon

meaning.en: A painting and writing technique of depicting surroundings in order to highlight the main subject.
meaning.zh: 国画技法，先涂染云彩来衬托月亮；比喻用侧面描写突出主体。

equivalents: bring out a subject by its surroundings

examples.zh: 作者用配角烘云托月，使主角形象更加鲜明。
examples.en: The author uses supporting characters to set off the protagonist.

examples.zh: 这幅画用烘云托月的手法，让月亮格外明亮。
examples.en: The painter smudges clouds to make the moon shine more brightly.

usage.en: A critical term in art and literary analysis. Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 艺术与文学评论术语。作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: To speak to the point, always saying the right thing.
meaning.zh: 一说话就说到点子上。

equivalents: hit the nail on the head

examples.zh: 他言必有中，大家都很信服。
examples.en: He always speaks to the point and everyone trusts him.

examples.zh: 老教授言必有中，一语道破问题所在。
examples.en: The old professor always hit the mark and exposed the problem in a few words.

story.en: In the Analects, the people of Lu discussed rebuilding the treasury; Min Ziqian said, 'He is not a man of many words, but when he speaks he always hits the mark.'

usage.en: Praise. Often 言必有中 describes a person known for sound judgement. Predicate.
usage.zh: 褒义，形容人说话切中要害，判断精准。作谓语。

meaning.en: Barely breathing, on the verge of death; also of a declining enterprise.
meaning.zh: 呼吸微弱，快要断气；也比喻事物衰败将尽。

examples.zh: 病人已经气息奄奄，医生全力抢救。
examples.en: The patient was barely breathing and the doctors fought to save him.

examples.zh: 这家老字号如今气息奄奄，难以为继。
examples.en: The old brand is on its last legs and can hardly carry on.

usage.en: 奄 is read yān here. Can describe people or institutions. Predicate.
usage.zh: “奄”读yān。可指人或机构。作谓语。

meaning.en: Not dare to act rashly or presume.
meaning.zh: 不敢轻率、鲁莽地行动。

examples.zh: 他是前辈，我在他面前不敢造次。
examples.en: He is my senior, so I would not dare be rash before him.

examples.zh: 情况不明，我们不敢造次。
examples.en: Until the facts are clear, we dare not act rashly.

usage.en: Humble or cautious register. Predicate.
usage.zh: 谦逊或谨慎语气。作谓语。

meaning.en: In writing, so it cannot be denied.
meaning.zh: 写在纸上的文字，指有书面凭据，抵赖不了。

examples.zh: 合同上白纸黑字写得清清楚楚，你不能反悔。
examples.en: It is written in black and white in the contract; you can't go back on it.

examples.zh: 白纸黑字的证据摆在面前，他无话可说。
examples.en: With the written evidence before him, he had no reply.

usage.en: Common in disputes about promises and contracts. Subject or object; often 白纸黑字写着.
usage.zh: 常用于合同、承诺纠纷。作主语、宾语，常说“白纸黑字写着”。

natural: not know about life and death

meaning.en: Reckless and unaware of the danger one is in.
meaning.zh: 不知道事情的利害，莽撞冒险。

equivalents: not know what one is getting into

examples.zh: 你这样不知死活地乱闯，会出事的。
examples.en: If you barge about so recklessly, something will go wrong.

examples.zh: 他不知死活地去挑战世界冠军。
examples.en: He foolishly went to take on the world champion.

usage.en: Colloquial and critical; often as a warning or insult. Predicate or adverbial.
usage.zh: 口语，批评口气，常作警告或责骂。作谓语、状语。

meaning.en: Poised and natural in manner, neither shy nor affected.
meaning.zh: 言谈举止自然大方，不拘束。

examples.zh: 她举止落落大方，给面试官留下好印象。
examples.en: She was poised and natural, and made a good impression on the interviewers.

examples.zh: 他在众人面前落落大方地发言。
examples.en: He spoke to the crowd with ease and composure.

usage.en: Praise for manners, mostly of young people. Predicate.
usage.zh: 称赞举止，多用于年轻人。作谓语。
